positions.description: Develop novel approaches to bot detection using machine learning.

positions.title: AI Fellow
positions.description:
• Developed computer vision to segment photo blemishes such as
redeye. Extended to non-blemish use-cases such as facial features.
• Engineered a GAN to complete an image with missing segments
trained on AWS utilizing S3 for data storage.
• Created a webapp to automate photo-editing fixing redeye, closed eyes, and incomplete smiles.

positions.title: Sr. Engineer - Data Scientist RF Capacity and Planning
positions.description:
• Implement and manage data warehouse for Verizon RF Systems including Planning, Design, Implementation and System Performance.
• Drive integration of inter-system feeds for automation and cutting edge analysis.
• Investigate and prevent data integrity issues automatically auditing billions of enterprise records.
Create automated dashboards and analysis for executive projects such as Long Term Planning and Superbowl.
• Kick off and drive the implementation of thousands of RF solutions for the Northern California submarket to deliver winning wireless metrics through capacity, performance, and external party measurements such as ROOT Metrics
• Work with regional and external planning groups to develop a yearly POR budget to exceed HQ goals.
• Market evangelist and mentor for modern analysis tools such as Tableau, Geospatial and Databases.
• Kick off and drive the implementation of thousands of solutions for the Northern California submarket to deliver winning wireless metrics through capacity, performance, and external party measurements such as ROOT Metrics. 
• Work with regional and external planning groups to develop a yearly POR budget to exceed HQ goals. 
• Work with numerous groups and teams to create new process and ensure their execution such as 5G, Capacity Prediction, and Network Modernization. Lead teams through cost reductions initiatives.

positions.title: LTE Tiger Team Manager
positions.description:
Managed a tiger team consisting of Real Estate, RF, Construction and Implementation Engineers to implement AWS and PCS LTE ground-based solutions:
• Developed and standardized PCS integrations for the Northern California region.
• Spearheaded the process for implementing new EME requirements including working with EME exceptions, working and developing vendors to meet EME requirements, and training team to adapt.
• Motivated team to work around the clock to provide extra network capacity during the World Series and holiday season
• Kept team on pace to meet yearly build plan by implementing creative solutions

positions.title: Automation Engineer
positions.description:
• Created, deployed, and maintained an end to end cell site database-driven design tool utilized on a daily basis by entire engineering team of over 200 people. The tool is more efficient and helps prevents errors and miscommunication between 10 different teams.
• Collaborated with RF and PM teams to convert existing excel trackers into a database to create executive reports without consuming PM resources.
• Developed and deployed a database-fed web application for implementing macro tower changes that will be critical to relaying cross-functional information for projects such as Site modification, LTE PCS/AWS deployment, and B2B sites.

positions.title: Engineer - Leadership Development Program
positions.description:
36 month leadership rotational program across network engineering teams. Present regularly to executives on accomplishments and recommendations.
Noteworthy accomplishments in each group include:
Fixed Network Engineering:
• Created the first comprehensive Networking Equipment Diagram for Northern CA that is still utilized implementation and troubleshooting.
• Led a team to create a Fixed Network Dashboard identifying capacity and performance problems.
RF Design
• Design Engineer for Yolo County Market, issued over 20 new build designs
• Analyzed and Proposed new design for cell cluster in Lake Tahoe.
RF Performance:
• Took responsibility for the cellular performance Central Coast Market
• Expanded the network through turn up optimizations of new builds and LTE
Project Management:
• Implemented and utilized tools to audit new build pipeline for sites affected by new Regulatory guidelines
• Collaborated with Switch Engineering, Operations, and RF to compile all integration information for over 500 LTE sites
• Project managed LTE integration to hit stretch goal of 503 LTE integrations in 2012 
Other Groups:
• Transport Engineering, Cell and Switch Operations, Area Planning

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Created software testing automation suite to reduce testing time from 2 weeks to 1 day.  Streamlined software update process by creating tools tailored to the various departments, reducing lead time from 2 weeks to 1 hour.

positions.title: Hard Design Co-op
positions.description: Simulated RAM Design to obtain timing and power characteristics and optimized future analysis using Perl scripting, and created Verilog RTL for the ram block for verification.
